front_blocks.md: Why are cells described as the basic building blocks of living organisms?

back_blocks.md: Because they are the basic **structural and functional units** of all living organisms.
**Unicellular** organisms are made from one cell; **multicellular** organisms are made from collections of cells.

front_blocks.md: All the cells in a multicellular organism are identical.

back_blocks.md: In complex multicellular organisms, cells are **specialised** to carry out particular functions, and these specialised cells group into tissues.

cards.front_md:
**True or False?**

All the cells in a multicellular organism are identical.
cards.back_md:
**False.**

In complex multicellular organisms, cells are **specialised** to carry out particular functions, and these specialised cells group into tissues.

front_blocks.md: A tissue is made up of different types of organ.

back_blocks.md: It is the other way round — a **tissue** is a group of similar cells, and an **organ** is made up of different tissues.
